networking.title: Simple Networked FPS
networking.subtitle: Multiplayer first-person shooter with Photon PUN networking
networking.intro_text: This project was created for the GPR5100.1 module at SAE Institute Geneva. The goal was to build a small multiplayer game to learn networking concepts. The game was developed with Unity 2019.3.0f3 using Photon PUN 2.16 technology.
networking.mechanics_text: Players spawn in a map with the objective to shoot their opponents. Each kill grants 100 points. The first player to reach 1,000 points wins the game. Players shoot balls that travel straight forward - one hit kills the target.
networking.control_move: Movement: W, A, S, D keys
networking.lobby_text: The game features a complete lobby system: players log in, join a random room (or create one if none exists), and can start the game when ready. The room closes and becomes invisible once the game starts.
networking.photon_view_text: The Photon View component is required on every networked GameObject. It enables sending RPCs and integrates with other components like Transform View Classic, Rigidbody View, and OnPhotonSerializeView. It also provides access to the Photon Actor Number to identify each player.
networking.transform_text: Photon PUN's Transform View Classic interpolates position and rotation of other clients' GameObjects, ensuring smooth movement synchronization across the network.
networking.rigidbody_text: The Rigidbody View sends player velocity to other clients, maintaining physics synchronization across the network.
networking.serialize_text: This function synchronizes custom data - in this project, it's used to sync player materials through the MaterialObservable script.
networking.rpcs_intro: RPCs update game state information and handle bullet instantiation across clients:
networking.rpc_spawn: Instantiates bullets at the same position for all players.
networking.rpc_points: Informs all clients about kills and score updates.
networking.rpc_end: Broadcasts the winner to all clients and triggers end game state.
networking.project_text: The project is organized with clear separation: Resources contain prefabs (Ball, Player), Scenes hold GameLauncher and GameScene, and Scripts are divided into GameScene logic (Bullet, GameManager, PlayerCamera, PlayerController) and Lobby UI (MainPanel, TopPanel).
networking.lesson_1: Practical experience with Photon PUN networking framework
networking.lesson_2: Understanding RPCs for game state synchronization
networking.lesson_3: Implementing lobby systems with room creation/joining
networking.lesson_4: Handling player interpolation and physics sync
